svg.title: ComfyUI-HyperFlow: interval conditioning and A/V envelope lock
svg.desc: (a) An eight-step sigma schedule: the sampler hops from each sigma to the next, and each step is conditioned on its interval, the current sigma and its endpoint. (b) Audio and video envelopes scroll in lock-step; measured correlation at 0 ms lag is +0.974 and +0.980 against a +0.136 unrelated-audio control.
svg.text: (a) Eight steps, each conditioned on its own σ interval
(b) Audio and video envelopes, correlation at 0 ms lag
